caption: A running sewing machine is unplugged, and the needle stops and its work light goes out.

sa.check: A sewing machine runs with its needle moving up and down and its work light lit.
Its plug is pulled out of the socket.
A cord runs from the machine to the plug.
The order is running, unplugged, needle still and light off.

pc.expect: The needle stops and the work light goes out together at the moment the plug leaves the socket.
pc.fail: The plug is out and the needle keeps stitching; or the light stays lit with the plug out; or the needle stops long before the plug moves; or the light goes out while the needle carries on running.

pc.expect: Once unplugged the needle stays still and the light stays off; the machine does not run again while the plug is out.
pc.fail: The needle starts stitching again with the plug out; or the light comes back on while unplugged; or the handwheel keeps turning after the needle has stopped.

pc.expect: While running, the needle moves straight up and down at one spot and the fabric passes under it in one direction.
pc.fail: The needle wanders across the fabric; or the fabric reverses direction while the needle runs; or the fabric keeps feeding after the needle has stopped.

pc.expect: The cord slackens and drops when the plug is free; the thread stays a limp thread and the fabric drapes as cloth.
pc.fail: The cord stands rigid in the air or stretches like elastic; or the thread stands stiff above the fabric like wire; or the fabric moves like a rigid plate.

pc.expect: One machine, one needle, one plug; the needle passes only through the fabric and the hole in the plate; the plug leaves the socket whole.
pc.fail: The needle passes through the plate beside its hole; or a second needle appears; or the plug vanishes; or the machine changes shape.

pc.expect: The machine's colour, the fabric's pattern and the thread stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The machine changes colour; or the fabric changes pattern; or the thread changes colour.
